exercises.name: Cat-cow
exercises.note: Warm the spine — move gently through the full range, don’t force the ends

exercises.name: Couch stretch
exercises.note: Back knee against sofa/wall, glute squeezed, torso tall — feel it in the front of the hip, not the lower back

exercises.name: 90/90 hip switch
exercises.note: Sit tall, rotate both knees side to side through 90/90, chest up — mobility, not a stretch to force

exercises.name: McGill curl-up
exercises.note: Hands under the low back, one knee bent; lift head and shoulders a touch and brace — keep the lower back still, never flatten or round it

exercises.name: Side plank
exercises.note: On knees if the full version aggravates anything; McGill dose — 5 holds, then 3, then 1

exercises.name: Bird dog
exercises.note: Hips level; McGill dose — 5 holds, then 3, then 1

exercises.name: Glute bridge
exercises.note: 2 s squeeze at the top, ribs down, don't arch the lower back

exercises.name: Dead bug
exercises.note: Lower back pressed into the floor

exercises.name: Standing pelvic tilt
exercises.note: Tuck into POSTERIOR tilt and hold a beat — the tuck is the rep. Practise 'run tall, tuck the pelvis'
